description: Canvas swapchain configure contract. Default path mirrors TS buildCanvasConfigureOptions() and WASM JS_CreateSurfaceFromCanvas + ConfigureSurface() (device.cpp). WASM keeps BOTH configures: JS (opaque + usage) then C++ (width/height + Fifo). Format is always navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat(). colorSpace/toneMapping defaults are the browser defaults and are not written explicitly on the default path. Enforced by verify:device-policy.

copySrc.note: Boot probe tries RENDER_ATTACHMENT|COPY_SRC inside a validation error scope, records the result, then restores render-only. Capture code reconfigures with copySrc only when the flag is true, for the duration of a GPU-encode take. TS: probeCanvasCopySrc() → window.webgpuProbe.canvasCopySrc. WASM: JS_CreateSurfaceFromCanvas probes before the contract configure → Module.pixelocityCanvasCopySrc; _setCanvasCopySrc → SetCanvasCopySrc() → ConfigureSurface() with canvasCopySrc_.

displayP3.note: Never requested at boot by default. Fail-soft to srgb when the browser rejects it or getConfiguration() reports a different colorSpace. TS-only: the C++ configures never write colorSpace/toneMapping.

extendedToneMapping.note: Only behind the display-p3 opt-in and only on an HDR display.
